title: Information Security Manager ( ISM )
jobDescription: We’re Hiring: Information Security Manager At Niramai Health Analytics, we are committed to building secure, compliant, and innovative healthcare solutions. We are looking for a skilled professional to lead our Information Security and Privacy initiatives, ensuring strong compliance, risk management, and a secure organizational environment. 📍 Location: Bengaluru Job Description: Ensure compliance with industry standards such as: ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, DPDP etc. Oversee & review the implementation of a sound Information Security and Privacy Policy to ensure continuous improvement. Implement / maintain information security policies by proactively involving in the business where security is an agenda. Ensure the appropriate level of privacy and security awareness as well as training is provided to staff in accordance with their function. Be the point of contact for Regulatory Bodies, government & law enforcement agencies on matters relating to security / privacy. Maintain documentation for audits and regulatory reviews Set up necessary processes & mechanisms within organization to support all formal regulatory & other agency requirements Engage with 3rd parties (Regulators & Vendors) for ISMS-related activities Assist CISO in all the ISMS related activities. Monitor the management of privacy and information security risks by: Reviewing major risk incidents for adequacy of response and controls; and Ensuring regular vulnerability assessments and risk reviews of the technology stack comprising systems and applications. Review incidents and monitor exposure to threats and impacts these may have on the continued operation of the Company. Competency Required: IT security and compliance, ISO 27001 Risk assessment & mitigation Security frameworks & controls Incident response leadership Strategic planning Strong communication and stakeholder management Analytical and problem-solving skills Prior experience in either hands-on software development or IT networking or IT administration is mandatory Qualification required: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity/ Information Technology/ Computer Science or related field Experience required: 4+ years in IT or cybersecurity Experience in IT management for regulated industry verticals (finance, healthcare, government) will be preferred.
